P125.title: 地震激励下列车−轨道−隧道−土体相互作用系统动力分析
P125.authors: 徐磊,王炫钧,余志武,李正
P125.journal_citation: 中南大学学报(自然科学版)
P125.label: 徐磊等（2024）

complete_examples.text: The dynamic response characteristics of the train −track −tunnel system were analyzed under different soil conditions and seismic intensities.

The results show that the seismic action can significantly increase the dynamic response of the train in the tunnel, in which the fluctuation of lateral wheel-rail force under different soil conditions increases significantly compared with that in the absence of seismic excitation, and the fluctuation amplitude increases by an average of 92.23%, while the fluctuation amplitude of the vertical wheel-rail force increases by an average of 7.14%, and the car body vertical and lateral acceleration increases by 89.50% and 25.93%, respectively.
求解地震作用下列车−轨道−隧道−土体相互作用系统动力响应是一个复杂的过程。
为研究地震激励下列车−轨道−隧道−土体相互作用系统的动力学行为,建立三维列车−轨道−隧道−土体耦合时变动力学模型,以不同强度的地震波和轨道不平顺为系统激励源,通过实际地震动记录进行规格化处理纵向、横向和垂向地震动波,分析不同土质条件、地震强度下列车−轨道−隧道−土体系统动力响应特征。
